coexistence_boundary_audit.current_true_statement: The mechanisms occupy disjoint graph phases and have a plausible sequential composition plan.
coexistence_boundary_audit.current_false_statement: The existing RTL blocks already implement one common typed interface or have proven shared-SRAM phase/barrier liveness.

paper_contribution_audit.correct_policy: Two or three grouped architectural mechanisms, never one contribution per milestone.

c1_rqtb.current_gap: No current Synopsys DC/PTPX/target-SRAM closure under M221's own eligibility rule; local core gain must not be sold as system gain.

c2_m167.current_gap: M167 independent review has five P0s covering numeric composition, barrier/controller/storage, coefficient generation, checkpoint accuracy and matched cycles.

c3_m216_m218.current_gap: M216-to-M218 connected cycle path and physical memory are absent; M220 is only a bounded M218-versus-M219 L4 directed miter.

patch.role: candidate extension or replacement after M222

p1_findings.finding: M221 says can_all_selected_layer_hardware_coexist=true, but no existing island implements the M221 typed wrapper and patch hardware does not yet exist.
p1_findings.impact: Without the nearby qualification this could be read as implemented coexistence.
p1_findings.required_followup: Keep the claim explicitly at graph-level feasibility and add one bounded adapter/wrapper canary before saying the hardware islands coexist.

p1_findings.finding: The phase list omits stage/block loops, per-block attention-FFN interleaving and baseline services for downsample/decoder/prediction/sn1.
p1_findings.impact: It cannot yet drive a faithful full-network sequential cycle sum.
p1_findings.required_followup: Freeze a hierarchical module iterator and baseline-service entries while retaining the thin local controller.

p1_findings.finding: The typed request lacks explicit memory space, port, address, burst, precision and credits, and no finite-buffer drain/liveness recurrence exists.
p1_findings.impact: One phase owner per cycle does not prove bank compatibility, port safety or deadlock freedom.
p1_findings.required_followup: Add an address-bearing tagged-union transaction and finite-depth backpressure/drain canary.

p1_findings.finding: M159 states fc1/fc2 share one Linear engine and sn1/sn2 share one ATLIF engine, while M221 adds M167 and M216+M218 without freezing which legacy functions or pools remain.
p1_findings.impact: The named-subblock dedup is correct, but total production resource replacement can still omit or double-count common compute.
p1_findings.required_followup: Create a baseline-to-proposed instance map with retain/replace/share status and count every retained engine once.

p1_findings.finding: The 128.0205M global ATLIF bucket includes services outside M167; M167 currently targets the post-FC1 BN1/sn2 path, whose frozen sn2 ATLIF portion is 36.48M cycles. It also does not implement the 118.370114M-cycle FC1 producer.
p1_findings.impact: Global ATLIF and FC1 shares cannot be used as achieved M167 coverage.
p1_findings.required_followup: Publish contribution-specific baseline cycle scopes and Amdahl sensitivity before selecting the final paper story.

p1_findings.finding: RQTB has exact RTL evidence and an OpenROAD proxy, but the frozen record says DC/PTPX/target SRAM are absent.
p1_findings.impact: It does not yet satisfy M221's own critical-module VCS-plus-DC eligibility list.
p1_findings.required_followup: Run the selected RQTB critical block through the same Synopsys/macro flow or soften the contribution eligibility wording.

p1_findings.finding: M167 has unresolved numeric/barrier/storage P0s and M216-to-M218 is not connected; M220 does not cover that connection.
p1_findings.impact: C2 and C3 are architectural candidates, not completed DATE contribution evidence packages.
p1_findings.required_followup: Close M167 checkpoint-bound numeric/barrier cycles and connected M216-to-M218 finite-memory cycles before contribution admission.

p1_findings.finding: C1, C2 and C3 are graph-disjoint but not yet tied by one measured shared dataflow or end-to-end result.
p1_findings.impact: A reviewer can read them as three independent tricks rather than one coherent accelerator.
p1_findings.required_followup: Use connected cycle/memory evaluation to select the final two or three and articulate one common exact temporal/context-amortization principle.

p2_findings: The selected_physical_islands list includes a patch hypothesis with no RTL; call it a candidate island until M222 advances.
The global hotspot table is useful prioritization evidence but not a coverage map for the proposed islands.
Absolute evidence paths are SHA-bound but not portable; a handoff should include a relative manifest or availability check.
The conditional known-logic subtotal is safe only because unified_area=false; its exclusions should enumerate all retained baseline services, not only the largest omissions.
allowed_claims: RQTB attention, post-FC1 BN1/sn2 temporal normalization, FC2 service and patch embed occupy disjoint operator scopes and have a plausible phase-ordered composition plan.
M221 correctly groups implementation milestones into candidate architectural contributions and excludes baselines, miters, censuses and superseded blocks from production counting.
The currently visible M167+M216+M218 logic-only subblock subtotal is 138927.726185 um2, explicitly excluding RQTB, patch, all SRAM and several required controllers/operators.
The frozen H67 hotspot and FC2 conditional sensitivity arithmetic in M221 is internally correct under its stated activity-weighted/pre-macro boundaries.
forbidden_claims: All selected hardware is already integrated or physically coexists.
Shared SRAM ports, dynamic-BN barriers or phase liveness are proved.
4.283680292x is achieved RTL or total-accelerator throughput per area.
Global ATLIF or FC1 hotspot share is fully accelerated by M167.
C1, C2 and C3 are all completed paper contributions.
Any local speedup multiplication, complete accelerator, system speedup or paper-ready PPA claim.

Freeze a baseline-to-proposed resource replacement ledger for Linear, ATLIF, attention, patch and SRAM instances.
Close M167 checkpoint numeric/barrier/storage and connected M216-to-M218 recurrence before paper-contribution admission.
Run RQTB through the selected Synopsys/macro evidence flow if it remains C1.
Continue M222 as a screen, but retain patch only if the same-resource cycle result passes its gate.
